name: Amphibian Survival Alliance Emergency Grants
summary: Rapid grants of up to US$5,000 for short, on-the-ground emergency action (rescue, habitat protection, disease response, field equipment) when an amphibian species or population faces extinction within about six months.

eligibility.rule: Species or population faces extinction within 6 months without intervention
The threat is acute, time-sensitive and well documented
The project provides immediate, short-term, on-the-ground action
The project can begin promptly and be implemented within a few months
The action can measurably reduce the risk of extinction
Funding covers only direct on-the-ground emergency response costs

documents: Evidence of urgency and feasibility, such as population data, threat assessments or action plans
Project budget using the ASA template

access.quote: Ready to apply? StatusOpen year-round FundingUp to $5,000 Apply now

eligibility.quote: You must demonstrate that your species or population faces extinction within 6 months without intervention.
Threat that is acute, time-sensitive, and well documented
Immediate, short-term, on-the-ground action (not planning, outreach, or long-term restoration)
Ready to begin promptly and implemented within weeks to a few months
Direct conservation action that can measurably reduce the risk of extinction
Direct costs for on-the-ground emergency response only

documents.quote: Upload any supporting documents (e.g., population data, threat assessments, action plans) that demonstrate the urgency of the situation and the feasibility of your proposed actions.
